nat-gateway-standardv2-zone-redundant.title: NAT Gateway StandardV2 is zone-redundant at the same price
nat-gateway-standardv2-zone-redundant.body: This estimate must keep running through a datacenter (zone) failure but uses NAT Gateway Standard, which supports a single availability zone. Microsoft states StandardV2 provides zone redundancy and costs the same, so choose standardv2.

citation.quote: Standard provides single availability zone support, whereas StandardV2 provides zone redundancy. Both are matched in price.
